_comment: Human nicknames for rooms of one building, used by the patrol agent.
The LitePT data only knows codes ('002_012') and types ('bedroom'), so a
command like '현우방만 탐색해줘' can ONLY resolve through this file.
Edit freely: keys are room_name (the <floor>_<room> dir suffix), values are
a list of aliases. They are injected into the LLM room directory and are
also matched by plain substring as a fallback when the LLM misses.
floor_offset: floor index 0 is displayed as this 층 number (1 = 0 -> '1층').
FIRST alias of each room = the name the web console prints for it (its
hardcoded LABELS table, web/드론 관제.dc.html). Those two lists MUST agree:
the user types the name they see on screen, and this file is the only
place that turns a name into a room. They used to disagree completely —
'현우방' resolved to 002_012, which the console draws as '채원의 금고가
있다는 소문의 방' — so asking for 현우's rooms selected 채원's. If you
change a label in the console, change it here in the same commit.
The bare given names (현우/규철/채원/민영/지윤) are deliberate: '현우방만
순찰해줘' has to select every room that belongs to 현우, not one of them.
Substring matching does the rest ('현우' is inside '현우방').
